1: // Simple Cosmic Courier game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // ----- Game state -----
12:   const player = {
13:     x: 80,
14:     y: canvas.height / 2,
15:     w: 30,
16:     h: 20,
17:     speed: 3,
18:     laser: 100, // energy %
19:     shooting: false,
20:     cooldown: 0,
21:   };
22:   const pods = [];
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   const drones = [];
25:   let score = 0;
26:   let gameOver = false;
27:   let frame = 0;
28: 
29:   // ----- Input -----
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
33: 
34:   // ----- Helpers -----
35:   function rand(min, max) {
36:     return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
37:   }
38:   function rectCircleColl(rect, cx, cy, cr) {
39:     const dx = Math.max(rect.x - cx, 0, cx - (rect.x + rect.w));
40:     const dy = Math.max(rect.y - cy, 0, cy - (rect.y + rect.h));
41:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= cr * cr;
42:   }
43: 
44:   // ----- Main loop -----
45:   function update() {
46:     if (gameOver) return;
47:     frame++;
48:     // player movement
49:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
50:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
51:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - player.h, player.y));
52: 
53:     // shooting
54:     if (keys[' '] && player.laser > 0 && player.cooldown <= 0) {
55:       player.shooting = true;
56:       player.laser -= 0.5; // drain energy per frame while firing
57:       player.cooldown = 10; // frames between shots
58:     } else {
59:       player.shooting = false;
60:     }
61:     if (player.cooldown > 0) player.cooldown--;
62: 
63:     // spawn objects
64:     if (frame % 80 === 0) asteroids.push({x: canvas.width, y: rand(0, canvas.height), r: rand(15, 30), speed: rand(2, 4)});
65:     if (frame % 120 === 0) drones.push({x: canvas.width, y: rand(0, canvas.height), r: 12, speed: 3});
66:     if (frame % 200 === 0) pods.push({x: canvas.width, y: rand(0, canvas.height), w: 15, h: 15, speed: 2});
67: 
68:     // move objects leftward
69:     const moveLeft = arr => arr.forEach(o => (o.x -= o.speed));
70:     moveLeft(asteroids);
71:     moveLeft(drones);
72:     moveLeft(pods);
73: 
74:     // remove off‑screen
75:     const clean = arr => arr.filter(o => o.x + (o.r || o.w) > 0);
76:     asteroids = clean(asteroids);
77:     drones = clean(drones);
78:     pods = clean(pods);
79: 
80:     // collisions with obstacles
81:     const shipRect = {x: player.x, y: player.y, w: player.w, h: player.h};
82:     for (const a of asteroids) if (rectCircleColl(shipRect, a.x, a.y, a.r)) gameOver = true;
83:     for (const d of drones) if (rectCircleColl(shipRect, d.x, d.y, d.r)) gameOver = true;
84: 
85:     // laser hits obstacles
86:     if (player.shooting) {
87:       const laserX = player.x + player.w;
88:       const laserY = player.y + player.h / 2;
89:       asteroids.forEach((a, i) => {
90:         if (Math.abs(a.x - laserX) < 10 && Math.abs(a.y - laserY) < a.r) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
91:       });
92:       drones.forEach((d, i) => {
93:         if (Math.abs(d.x - laserX) < 10 && Math.abs(d.y - laserY) < d.r) drones.splice(i, 1);
94:       });
95:     }
96: 
97:     // collect cargo pods
98:     pods.forEach((p, i) => {
99:       if (
100:         p.x < player.x + player.w &&
101:         p.x + p.w > player.x &&
102:         p.y < player.y + player.h &&
103:         p.y + p.h > player.y
104:       ) {
105:         score += 10;
106:         pods.splice(i, 1);
107:       }
108:     });
109:   }
110: 
111:   function draw() {
112:     // starfield background
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
114:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
116:     for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
117:       const sx = rand(0, canvas.width);
118:       const sy = rand(0, canvas.height);
119:       ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, 1);
120:     }
121:     // player ship (triangle)
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
123:     ctx.beginPath();
124:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h / 2);
125:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y);
126:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
127:     ctx.closePath();
128:     ctx.fill();
129:     // laser beam
130:     if (player.shooting && player.laser > 0) {
131:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff0';
132:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
133:       ctx.beginPath();
134:       ctx.moveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h / 2);
135:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, player.y + player.h / 2);
136:       ctx.stroke();
137:     }
138:     // asteroids
139:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
140:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
141:       ctx.beginPath();
142:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
143:       ctx.fill();
144:     });
145:     // drones
146:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
147:     drones.forEach(d => {
148:       ctx.beginPath();
149:       ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
150:       ctx.fill();
151:     });
152:     // cargo pods
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
154:     pods.forEach(p => {
155:       ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
156:     });
157:     // HUD
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
159:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
160:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
161:     ctx.fillText('Laser: ' + Math.floor(player.laser) + '%', 10, 40);
162:     if (gameOver) {
163:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
164:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
165:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
166:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
167:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
168:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
169:     }
170:   }
171: 
172:   function loop() {
173:     update();
174:     draw();
175:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
176:   }
177: 
178:   // start the game
179:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
180: })();
